features.title: Alchemy, not spellcasting
features.text: Prepare bombs, elixirs, poisons and mutagens, then make temporary items during an adventure. Your research field helps shape your specialty.

features.title: Choose your toolkit
features.text: You can damage foes, heal companions or solve practical problems. Learning formulas and choosing who receives each item are central decisions.

review.notes: Editorial assessment of the class framework and ordinary builds. Rules references support mechanics; scores remain judgments.

ratings.offense: 3 → 2.5–4. Bombs, mutagens and poisons produce different damage specialists; weaknesses and splash matter.
ratings.defense: 2.5 → 2.5–4. Mutagen and defensive item choices can substantially improve personal resilience.
ratings.support: 4 → 3–5. Chirurgeon healing and shared elixirs favor support; a selfish damage loadout contributes less.
ratings.utility: 5 → 5. A broad formula collection solves many exploration problems, within item and action limits.
ratings.difficulty: 4.5 → 4.5. Formula knowledge, daily preparation and selecting the right consumable require substantial study.
